trials.claim: Lifetime access to MarkupGo on all plans
trials.claimQuote:
Lifetime access to MarkupGo
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
trials.reasoning: The binding terms let MarkupGo terminate or suspend access at any time, without notice, for any reason, which materially limits the promised lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: MarkupGo reserves the right to terminate or suspend access to its services at any time, without prior notice or liability, for any reason whatsoever.
exhibits.argument: Vendor can terminate access at any time for any reason, which voids the promise of lifetime access.

trials.claim: Plan 3 includes 5,000 credits per month and Unlimited templates
trials.claimQuote:
Stack up to 7 codes
- 5,000 credits per month
- Unlimited templates
- Full API access
trials.reasoning: E2 only says PDF downloads cost 3 credits; it does not dispute that Plan 3 provides 5,000 credits per month or unlimited templates, and no supporting exhibit is shown.

exhibits.quote: The only thing I think could be clearer is that downloading PDFs costs 3 credits-this information isn't very visible at first.
exhibits.argument: PDF downloads cost 3 credits each, so 5,000 credits per month yields far fewer conversions than claimed.
